title: RONIN — inventario de 32 dominios y 64 bibliotecas General/HKD

policy.disjointness: global exact SHA-256 and global near-duplicate cluster; General and HKD must not share documents or duplicate clusters
policy.split_policy: train/validation/test are deterministic and disjoint; validation/test/holdout are never training data
policy.note: Admission uses the legacy-scoped evidence bar, not a new blanket territorial re-audit. Candidate metadata alone never counts as text.
policy.admission_standard_description: Level A follows the scoped evidence standard that admitted literature-es-v1: anonymous public access; pinned immutable source revision; per-document provenance and rights record; payload/document SHA-256; deterministic disjoint train/validation/test; zero exact duplicates in train; recorded human/quality audit; prior PII/secrets scan. No additional blanket ES/EU/US territorial reconciliation is required where this scoped evidence is recorded. Third-party exclusions, privacy, integrity, quality, attribution and split isolation remain mandatory.
policy.training_eligibility_note: G-0 remains an independent global gate; scoped admitted corpora may retain their own training_eligible status under their own manifest.

rights_registry_snapshot.note: Level-A records include metadata-only records and CoVoST candidate payloads; none is admitted into these 64 libraries. Level B BOE records remain excluded from the Level-A minimum.

legacy_scoped_corpus.reason: Meets the scoped legacy admission standard: pinned public-domain source revisions, document-level provenance/rights, payload/document hashes, deterministic disjoint partitions, zero train exact duplicates, and recorded prior quality/human and privacy audits.

review_status_summary.owner_attested_human_review_coverage: all datasets and document collections mapped as of 2026-11-05
review_status_summary.technical_admission: pending exact-payload validation, NASA redistribution recheck, global deduplication, split isolation and General/HKD materialization
review_status_summary.file_level_review: 8 NASA text files manually inspected: 4 content-legibility passes remain candidate-only; 3 held for severe OCR repair; 1 held because individual rights metadata is unresolved and OCR is poor. Three ScienceVerse metadata/routing anomalies remain documented and held. No NASA documents admitted; global deduplication, redistribution recheck and split isolation remain pending.
review_status_summary.owner_authored_papers: Nine owner-authorized Markdown papers from orbitalronin94/Papers are copied byte-for-byte into a scoped admitted corpus; README.md excluded. They are not yet counted toward Level A library minimums or eligible for training pending global deduplication, quality/privacy and partition gates.
review_status_summary.nasa_file_reviewed_corpus: Six individually file-reviewed NASA NTRS documents copied byte-for-byte into a scoped corpus. Four reviewed holds remain excluded. The remaining 814 NASA candidate texts are not individually reviewed. No Level-A counter or training eligibility change.
review_status_summary.scoped_nasa_admission: 813/824 NASA NTRS records admitted to a scoped corpus; 11 held; all training-ineligible pending global G-0.
review_status_summary.scienceverse_candidate_audit: All 7,403 exported ScienceVerse documents machine-audited for full-text quality and basic PII patterns: 7,337 quality passes, 66 holds, 15 missing author metadata. None admitted pending rights/third-party reconciliation and global dedup.

scoped_candidate_admissions.note: 813 admitted as scoped records after item-level NASA rights allowlist, exact source hashes, full-text quality screening and individual holds; HTML/Tika wrappers normalized. 4 manual holds and 7 quality holds remain. Weekly redistribution recheck and cross-source exact/near dedup, final partition gates still pending.
